name: Websites - Authorized - Internal Sharepoint Domains [is]
description: Intent: Authorized internal SharePoint domains — populate with fully-qualified SharePoint tenant hosts (e.g., acme.sharepoint.com, acme.onmicrosoft.com) that host internal document libraries. Drives the Internal SharePoint carve-out on D1031 — distinct from the general cloud-storage surface so internal collaboration stays low-noise. Top priority if your org runs SharePoint Online. Exclusions: do not add external partner SharePoint sites; do not add personal OneDrive (covered by the general Cloud Storage authorized-domain list).
